title: Citrusy Pilaf with Velvety Sauce
description: A warm and comforting pilaf infused with citrus flavors, topped with a creamy velvety sauce.

ingredients.name: Velvety sauce
ingredients.notes: see below for velvety sauce ingredients

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add citrus zest and cook for 1 minute.
Add pilaf and stir to coat with oil mixture.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir velvety sauce into pilaf and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional citrus zest if desired.
